sidebar.title: Create your FinCore account
sidebar.description: Set up your account and choose how you want to use the FinCore platform.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Tell us how you want to use FinCore.

chooseBanks.title: Choose banks
chooseBanks.description: Choose the banks you want to connect with.

companyProfile.title: Company profile
companyProfile.description: Provide additional information about your business.

businessNeeds.title: Business needs
businessNeeds.description: Choose the financial services your company may need.

bankingPreference.title: Banking preference
bankingPreference.description: Choose how your company wants to work with banks.

bankInfo.title: Bank information
bankInfo.description: Provide the basic legal information about your bank.

bankType.title: Bank type
bankType.description: Choose the type of bank you are creating.

targetCustomers.title: Target customers
targetCustomers.description: Choose the customer segments your bank will serve.

initialProducts.title: Initial products
initialProducts.description: Choose which banking products will be available initially.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Configure the initial visual identity of your bank.

brokerInfo.title: Broker information
brokerInfo.description: Provide information about your brokerage organization.

brokerType.title: Broker type
brokerType.description: Choose the type of broker organization.

services.title: Services
services.description: Choose the services your brokerage will provide.

clientTypes.title: Client types
clientTypes.description: Choose the types of clients you plan to work with.

initialPartners.title: Initial partners
initialPartners.description: Optionally choose banks you want to work with.

review.title: Review
review.description: Review your information before creating the account.

personal.title: Personal Banking
personal.description: Manage your personal accounts, cards, payments and connected banks.

company.title: Company
company.description: Manage your company, employees, payroll, accounting, taxes and banking.

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: Create and configure your own banking organization on FinCore.

broker.title: Broker
broker.description: Create a brokerage organization and connect clients with financial products.

personal.bankNote: Choosing a bank creates a banking relationship. Products and additional services can be configured later.

needs.payrollDescription: Manage salary payments and payroll runs.

companyBanking.connectExistingDescription: Connect your company to one or more existing banks.
companyBanking.createBankDescription: Create a separate banking organization later and connect it with your company.
companyBanking.laterDescription: Create the company now and configure banking relationships later.

bankTypes.retailDescription: Bank focused primarily on individual customers.
bankTypes.businessDescription: Bank focused primarily on companies and entrepreneurs.
bankTypes.universalDescription: Bank providing services to both individuals and businesses.
bankTypes.specializedDescription: Bank focused on a specific market or financial segment.

bank.productsNote: You can configure additional products and capabilities after the bank has been created.

broker.partnersOptional: Initial partner banks are optional. Partnerships can also be created later from the broker workspace.

review.companyOwner: You will become the Owner of the new company.
review.bankOwner: You will become the Owner of the new bank.
review.brokerOwner: You will become the Owner of the new broker organization.
review.confirm: I confirm that the information provided is correct and agree to create this account.
